method: Every assigned atlas page was emitted as an image and visually compared source-left versus overlay-right; eleven suspicious tiles were additionally viewed as separate 1280px source and overlay images. Metadata checks were used only after visual review for source attribution.
policy: Ambiguous visual/semantic source differences are preserved when XODR objects or driving lanes exist. Previously proven conversion/OSGB repairs stay; missing controllers are never invented.
limitations: Visual coverage is a review at atlas resolution and selected 1280px enlargements, not a proof of all dynamic signal phases or all microscopic geometry properties.
Source-paint disagreement and off-road source primitives are documented separately; preserve_by_xodr_policy does not certify the source scene as physically correct.
Signal controller/lamp movement restrictions remain subject to the previously recorded API and physical-arrow limitations.
